nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all twelve questions are required; each printed part is a practice card at its published tariff. “1 mharc + 1 mharc” answers expose one-mark slots (A3(b)(i), A4(b)(i), B2(b)(ii), B3(b)(i), B3(b)(ii)); “2 mharc + 1 mharc” items (A2(a), B2(a), B3(a), B4(a), B5(a) and both 6(a)) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) has two independent six-mark traits (trait 2 + support 4) with practice slots; B 6(b) is an opinion (2) and two supported points (5 + 5) inside one response (no slots, as in 2026 B 6(b)). Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff); A3(a) prints its partial as “bronntar 2 mharc”.
Prose, poetry and Q4 choices are closed printed routes (4 + 4 + 6) and were already carded (IDs retained); the optional folktale, short story or poem itself is open content chosen by the candidate.
Scheme lists of accepted points and supporting notes are indicative answer keys, not route pools.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12), Prós 30, Filíocht 30, Litríocht Bhreise 40.
Reading A “Tom Crean – Taiscéalaí Ciarraíoch an Antartaigh” (paper 4–5, scheme PDF 19–22); B “2022: Bliain Eorpach na hÓige” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 22–26).

Literature language: 5 marks for Gaeilge in every literature answer (scheme PDF 28); prose 25 Eolas (18 column for a one-aspect answer); poetry printed (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 on the paper, assessed as Eolas 13, 5, 7 plus Gaeilge 5 once; Q4 Eolas 35 (25 for 4A with one character); 4F printed (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10, assessed as Eolas 19, 7, 9 (5 + 4) plus Gaeilge 5.

Paper vs scheme wording: A1(b)(ii) the scheme adds “soir” (cuairt ghearr soir); B6(b) the paper says “Bliain Eorpach na hÓige 2022”, the scheme omits “2022”; 4F(iii) the paper adds “sa dán”. Cards keep the paper wording.

Scheme layout: the text layer stores each poetry band table (Plé 11/13, Marc as 5) and the 4F Marc as 7 table after the following sub-question; the generator returns each table to the sub-question it is printed beside.
Cover (PDF 1, printed as an image): the 2023 papers were adjusted to compensate for COVID-19 learning disruption. The cards follow the printed 2023 structure; the note offers no choice.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): the twelve whole reading questions each had one undivided criterion; the four poetry routes had one undivided 25-mark Eolas criterion, and for both prescribed poems (3A) its guidance began at (ii), with the (i) scheme missing; every literature route carried a paraphrased Gaeilge band (“sásúil”) instead of the printed table. All now carry the lifted 2023 scheme text and part tariffs.
